item.name: Extract PDF of receipts associated to an Expense Report

request.name: Extract PDF of receipts associated to an Expense Report

description.content: This method returns a PDF file of all the images associated with an Expense Report or with the line items within the report.

query.description: Voucher invoice number.
The Report ID is a 12-digit number generated by Chrome River that begins with 0100. Be sure to omit the dashes.
If selected, PDF will include mileage details, including map and distance, if expense was created using Maps
If selected, PDF will include receipt images attached to the report
If selected, the original PDF is retrieved first, if available.
If selected, the original PDF will include approval notes
If selected, the images will be retrieved before any PDFs
